arm_candidate.identity: new student trained on actual same-prefix 75% Echo4 + 25% Sapling CE. Only the Sapling payload may differ from registered parent; preserve .75/.25, same features, style, root ordering, both return-residual decoders, fixed return coefficients, all safety/fallback, no search change.

control: same compute, same data individual CE student in serving/control.py to be evaluated as separate diagnostic, never substituted for either registered arm

admission.source: read back this registration from main; compare all expert/student/package and split hashes
admission.ce: use all originally val cached shards in signed data_split (split=val, one map one vote), normalized softmax on each active valid worker/base slot with at least two legal actions, actual demonstration command and prefix common to both networks, mean over valid selected slots per map then equal-map mean. Frozen numeric criterion CE(candidate 75/25) strictly < CE(parent 75/25), excluding identical one-choice slots. Validate every used val physical terrain/seed/ID absent candidate training panels. Always report identical-scored control.
admission.entry_probe: fresh module per game per arm, warm real public agent from turn 0 through t=298 on four archived V1 trajectories, seeds 621477120 and 621477121, both seats; test only t=19,39,59,79,99,119,139,159,179,199,219,239,259,279,297. Require >=1 distinct executed joint command; retained legal and finite. Same actual pre-action public seat histories/hidden game state excluded. Probe games previously exposed, are not new developer or formal games.
admission.parity: Separately compare frozen deployed expert/sapling quantized heads to corresponding torch logits on identical held prefixes; ensure argmax/finite/legality validation, return residual safety readback. No additional effect-size gate or outcome selection.

new_dev.collision_procedure: Before any candidate results, verify seed and equivalent physical opening vs frozen repository and known training/validation/cache; only on true prior collision predeclare next consecutive unused pair before training/arena evidence. Both chosen maps excluded from future formal banks.

native.termination: official turn limit or official extinction; no picked seats, no truncated or proxy matches
native.scheduling: paired parent/candidate per map/seat in order, alternating CPU0/1 by both map and seat. Acquire shared continuation.lock. Preserve real examiner natural clock and unrestricted production search budget. Save per-turn depth/fallback, root wall costs and observed host competition; report unavailable intervals. No added cognitive work inside decision loop.

report: All eight, official margin and WDL, both seats, by map and paired mean differences, complete received/deposited/raided/trees/hiring/collision accounts with exact sources, and timing. Two development maps do not certify 90% / +500.
